content: Second, the comparison between scenario Hierarchical-kv and Hierarchical-k shows that omitting entirely the influence of the record values in the attention mechanism is more effective: this last variant performs slightly better in all metrics excepted CS-R%, reinforcing our intuition that focusing on the structure modeling is an important part of data encoding as well as confirming the intuition explained in Section SECREF16: once an entity is selected, facts about this entity are relevant based on their key, not value which might add noise. To illustrate this intuition, we depict in Figure FIGREF27 attention scores (recall $\alpha _{i,t}$ and $\beta _{i,j,t}$ from equations (SECREF16) and (DISPLAY_FORM17)) for both variants Hierarchical-kv and Hierarchical-k. We particularly focus on the timestamp where the models should mention the number of points scored during the first quarter of the game. Scores of Hierarchical-k are sharp, with all of the weight on the correct record (PTS_QTR1, 26) whereas scores of Hierarchical-kv are more distributed over all PTS_QTR records, ultimately failing to retrieve the correct one.
